training.corpus: synthetic grammar over the 25-entry vocabulary (subject, verb, object, place, and "then it ..." follow-ups)

place.question: All heads on: after “the dog ran to the”, is a place or an animal more likely?
All heads on: after “the bird sat under the”, is a place or an animal more likely?
All heads on: after “the cat slept on the”, is a place or an animal more likely?

training.question: After “the dog chased the”, which weights give the specific target “cat” a lower loss? Compare this target, even if it is an unusual continuation.
After “the bird sat under the”, which weights give the specific target “bed” a lower loss? Compare this target, even if it is an unusual continuation.
After “the cat sat on the”, which weights give the specific target “cat” a lower loss? Compare this target, even if it is an unusual continuation.

future.question: Compare “a dog ran to the mat” and “a dog ran to the bed”. At “dog” (position 2), are the next-token distributions the same?
Compare “the bird sat on the mat” and “the bird sat on the bed”. At “sat” (position 3), are the next-token distributions the same?
Compare “a cat sat under the mat” and “a cat sat under the bed”. At “cat” (position 2), are the next-token distributions the same?

controls.question: In “the dog ran to the” versus “the dog saw to the”, which variable changes? This is a controlled prompt comparison, including inputs outside the training grammar.
In “the bird sat under the” versus “the bird saw under the”, which variable changes? This is a controlled prompt comparison, including inputs outside the training grammar.
In “the cat sat on the” versus “the cat saw on the”, which variable changes? This is a controlled prompt comparison, including inputs outside the training grammar.

sufficiency.question: For “the dog ran to the”, keep only layer 0, head 1 active among the attention heads. Do you predict more than 50% probability of a place? Embeddings, MLPs and all other model operations remain.
For “the bird sat under the”, keep only layer 0, head 1 active among the attention heads. Do you predict more than 50% probability of a place? Embeddings, MLPs and all other model operations remain.
For “the cat sat on the”, keep only layer 0, head 1 active among the attention heads. Do you predict more than 50% probability of a place? Embeddings, MLPs and all other model operations remain.

confidence.question: After “the dog chased the”, change temperature from 1 to 2. Will the identity of the highest-probability next token change? No token is sampled.
After “the bird sat on the”, change temperature from 1 to 0.5. Will the identity of the highest-probability next token change? No token is sampled.
After “the cat ran home”, change temperature from 1 to 3. Will the identity of the highest-probability next token change? No token is sampled.

scope: Computed teaching-model fixtures. Worked-comparison outcomes are included for reproducibility. They are freely visible and do not assess learning.
hash_normalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 text with CRLF normalized to LF
